facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal says the national treasury (TGR) had established and extended the Integrated Revenue Management System for local authorities (GIR-CT), and that new GIR-CT features covering the whole chain from tax base to recovery were to be made available to municipalities; the TGR collects all municipal revenues except the professional tax.
